    Killing through an endomorphism ring generated by a loop #

    For a distributive split basic algebra, if every non-invertible endomorphism ray of a vertex is a power of the ray of a loop ℓ, then the endomorphism ring of the projective is generated by any representative ℓ̂ (adjoin_loop_eq_top). Hence g ≫ u ≫ f = 0 for every endomorphism u once g ≫ ℓ̂ⁿ ≫ f = 0 for all n (comp_end_comp_eq_zero).
